milestones.title: Core & Context Engine
milestones.description: Foundational data schemas, multi-graph state, validation engine, context compiler for prompt generation, and rolling-wave task finisher.
milestones.targetOutcome: Robust CLI and SSOT state machine capable of validating and compiling LLM prompt context for coding agents.
deliverables: Task completion and rolling-wave advance script (complete-task)

milestones.title: Multi-Graph React Flow UI
milestones.description: Interactive local visual dashboard featuring multi-layered React Flow canvas (Roadmap, Architecture, Codebase, Rolling Wave, and Ideation sticky notes).
milestones.targetOutcome: Developers can visually inspect, create, connect, and update project state without manual JSON editing.
deliverables: Custom React Flow nodes for Milestones, Modules, APIs, Tasks
Real-time bidirectional sync with .project-control/ via local server

milestones.title: Meta-Skill & Rule Generator
milestones.description: Automated generation of Antigravity / Cursor / Claude Code skills, instruction files, and architectural guardrails from the SSOT graph.
milestones.targetOutcome: Coding agents automatically receive updated workspace rules and skills whenever architecture changes.

milestones.title: Codebase Scanner & Drift Auditor
milestones.description: Static analysis tool scanning the filesystem to observe real imports, files, and functions, diffing against intended architecture to flag architectural drift.
milestones.targetOutcome: Zero architectural drift; CI and pre-commit checks alert developers if unmapped files or unauthorized layer violations occur.
deliverables: Visual drift warnings in UI and CLI

milestones.title: CLI Packaging & Ecosystem Distribution
milestones.description: Unified global CLI executable (vibe / vibe-control) with init, validate, ui, and compile commands ready for npx and npm global installation.
milestones.targetOutcome: Any developer can run `npx vibe-control init` in any repository to bootstrap visual project control.
